Inauguration d’un hub technologique stra: Inauguration of a strategic technology hub for businesses
OULED FAYET, 23 juin 2026 — Ooredoo a of: OULED FAYET, June 23, 2026 — Ooredoo officially launched its ICT Solutions Center, an innovative technological space located within its Ouled Fayet headquarters. This project is part of the operator's strategy to develop its B2B activities and offer cutting-edge technological solutions to Algerian businesses. Designed as an innovation hub, the ICT Solution Center allows for the exhibition and testing of solutions covering Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Connectivity, the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Managed Services. According to data from the Post and Electronic Communications Regulation Authority (ARPCE), Algerian companies are expected to invest more than 150 billion dinars by 2028 in digital transformation.
Ce pôle stratégique vise à répondre aux: This strategic hub aims to meet the growing needs of businesses in terms of digitalization. In 2025, the Algerian B2B solutions market recorded 8% growth, driven by the accelerated adoption of cloud and cybersecurity technologies. The ICT Solution Center will offer a collaborative environment promoting the discovery of emerging technologies and the co-creation of innovative solutions. The project mobilized several departments within the company to ensure an offering tailored to the performance and competitiveness challenges of local businesses.
L’inauguration de l’ICT Solutions Center: The inauguration of the ICT Solutions Center by Ooredoo takes place in a context marked by increased demand from Algerian companies for integrated digital solutions. According to the 2025 annual report by ARPCE, the fixed internet penetration rate in Algeria reached 22% in 2025, while the B2B services market shows an annual growth rate of 10%. This project will help reduce the dependence of Algerian companies on foreign solutions by offering them secure and adapted local alternatives. Furthermore, it will contribute to the creation of skilled jobs in the information technology sector, in line with the objectives of the government's 2030 digital plan.
Sur le plan technologique, l’ICT Solutio: Technologically speaking, the ICT Solutions Center will strengthen Algeria's capabilities in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence. In 2025, the country recorded an 18% increase in cyberattacks, highlighting the urgency of having robust local infrastructures. This hub will also serve as a platform to train corporate executives in the use of new technologies, in collaboration with national universities and training centers.
Contexte du secteur TIC algérien: Context of the Algerian ICT sector
En 2025, l’Algérie comptait 52 millions: In 2025, Algeria had 52 million mobile subscribers, representing a penetration rate of 115%. The B2B services market, dominated by operators such as Algérie Télécom, Mobilis, and Djezzy, represents an annual turnover of 350 billion dinars. ARPCE recorded a 25% increase in investments in digital infrastructure in 2025, with a dedicated budget of 400 billion dinars allocated by the State for the 2030 digital plan. The wilayas of Algiers, Oran, and Constantine concentrate 60% of the sector's B2B activities.
Le marché algérien des solutions cloud a: The Algerian cloud solutions market experienced 15% growth in 2025, reaching a volume of 120 billion dinars. Local businesses are gradually adopting AI technologies, with a 30% increase in projects dedicated to process automation. Algeria ranks 112th out of 193 countries in the ITU ICT Development Index for 2025, moving up 10 places compared to 2023.
Le Directeur Général de Ooredoo, M. Roni: The CEO of Ooredoo, Mr. Roni Tohme, emphasized: "The inauguration of Ooredoo's ICT Solution Center is a major milestone in our ambition to consolidate our company's positioning as a benchmark technological partner. This platform will allow our clients to benefit from our expertise and support in their digital transformation projects by offering them a space for innovation, demonstration, and co-development of solutions tailored to their needs. Through this technological space, we reaffirm our commitment to putting the most advanced technologies at the service of the performance and competitiveness of Algerian companies."
Pour sa part, le président de l’APW de l: For his part, the president of the APW of the wilaya of Algiers, Mr. Mohamed Lamine Belhadj, welcomed this initiative: "This project is part of the modernization dynamic of the Algerian economic fabric. Wilayas must play a key role in supporting local businesses toward digitalization, in collaboration with operators like Ooredoo."
Ooredoo prévoit d’étendre les services d: Ooredoo plans to extend the services of the ICT Solution Center to other wilayas by 2027, specifically targeting the wilayas of Oran, Constantine, and Annaba. The project is part of the 2030 digital plan, which aims to bring the fixed internet penetration rate to 30% by 2028. Companies will be able to benefit from personalized support for their digital transformation projects, with a focus on SMEs and startups.
À moyen terme, l’opérateur envisage de l: In the medium term, the operator plans to launch training programs in partnership with universities and training centers to strengthen local skills in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence. This project adds to the 20 billion dinars in investments planned by Ooredoo for the development of its B2B infrastructure by 2028.
